### No Other Name
Author: Alistair Begg (Truth For Life)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-january-19-2024.html
Passage: Acts 4:12
Points:
- Modern culture mirrors ancient Rome by encouraging people to view Jesus as merely one religious path among many.
- Peter and John faced hostility because they refused to add Christ to an accepted pantheon of worldviews.
- Diluting Christ's exclusive claim undermines the gospel, as no other source can grant rescue from eternal death.
- Believers are called to imitate the apostles' courage and faithfully proclaim Jesus as the only Savior.

### There Is a Name: Our Exclusive and Precious Christ
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/there-is-a-name
Passage: Acts 4:12
Points:
- Believers can feel hesitant or embarrassed when sharing Christ's exclusive claims in a pluralistic culture.
- A true awareness of human sin reveals that God was under no obligation to provide any path of rescue.
- The provision of Jesus's name is a lavish display of grace rather than an act of divine limitation.
- Because this saving name is given under all heaven, Christians should eagerly bring it to every nation.
